title: Devil's Throat Rising
author: Ivo Underhill
blurb: Ada Brightwater, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
